URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/1/school-protests-spread-as-fires-blockades-deepen-unrest-in-france
Al Jazeera — confirmed published 1 October 2026, 19:18 BST. Headline: "School protests spread as fires, blockades deepen unrest in France"

Trigger: students protesting overcrowded classrooms, teacher shortages and crumbling school facilities.

Scale: roughly 160 schools shut down by mid-morning Thursday; some 340 demonstrations outside high schools.

QUOTE (Laurent Nunez, French Interior Minister): "more than 400 have been detained, many of them minors."

Injuries: authorities reported "many dozens of injuries" from thrown objects and police riot-control projectiles. Several school principals were injured, harassed or assaulted during blockades.

Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu convened a crisis meeting and asked ministers to cancel upcoming travel to focus on the demonstrations. Education Minister is Edouard Geffray.

QUOTE (Raphael, 17-year-old student): "There are 35 of us per classroom. With 35 degrees Celsius in summer, it's unbearable."

Jean-Luc Melenchon, presidential candidate, called for nonviolent methods of struggle.
